bullets.title: NVDA: Jensen Huang guides chip shipments to 2x next year; Jefferies/JPM raise estimates
bullets.body: Multiple sources corroborate Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's statement that chip unit sales are expected to roughly double next year on broad AI adoption. JPM raised NVDA estimates +4% for 2027/28 on stronger Rubin/Rubin Ultra ramp; Feynman confirmed on 3D SoIC logic-logic stacking in 2028. Jefferies semis bus tour with NVDA CFO reinforces 70% baseline datacenter growth, 50% of revenue from non-hyperscaler customers, and supply—not demand—as the key constraint. Hedgeye Risk Range changed NVDA from Neutral to Bullish trend signal.

bullets.title: CLS: JPM OW on OpenAI single-source win; $3B equity raise funds 2027 ramp
bullets.body: Celestica is single-sourced for OpenAI's first-generation rack program with potential to remain launch partner for future generations. AMD scale-up switch programs expected to contribute multiple billions in 2027 revenue with no current second source. The $3B equity raise covers working capital for the revenue ramp; no further raises needed for 2027, with 2028 decision pushed to 2H27. Operating margin expansion expected at the corporate level despite compute mix headwinds.

bullets.title: NFLX: Wells Fargo downgrades to Underweight, $57 PT on engagement trends
bullets.body: Wells Fargo analyst Steven Cahall cut Netflix to Underweight with a $57 price target, implying ~24% downside from $75.31, citing deteriorating engagement trends. Stock fell 3.3-3.5% pre-market. FactSet consensus PT is $94.54 with a range of $70-$135, making this a notably bearish outlier call.

bullets.title: INTU: Investor Day viewed as deliberate reset; Big Bets growing 30%+ but FY27 guidance unchanged
bullets.body: Multiple brokers covered INTU's Investor Day. KeyBanc maintains OW at $400 PT; Mizuho reiterates OW at $430 PT; UBS stays Neutral at $360 PT. The consensus: Big Bets (Assisted Tax, Money, Mid-Market) represent ~30% of revenue and growing >30% Y/Y, but FY27 guidance was unchanged and viewed as conservative. Execution on customer growth conversion to higher ARPC SKUs is the key debate. COGS expected to outpace revenue in FY27 on AI investment.

bullets.title: HUBS: UNBOUND investor day; FY30 30% margin target raised, AI adoption accelerating but growth visibility lacking
bullets.body: JPM raises PT to $268 (from lower); Mizuho Outperform at $260; KeyBanc OW at $285; UBS Buy PT to $290. Breeze Assistant Pro+ penetration rose from 37% to 57%; monthly credit consumption more than doubled. FY27 non-GAAP op margin guided 23-24%, FY30 target raised to 30% (vs. prior 25%). Revenue re-acceleration remains the critical catalyst for re-rating—management did not provide mid-term growth guidance, and COGS will outpace revenue in FY27.

bullets.title: T (AT&T): JPM raises PT to $33, top pick on convergence momentum and fiber adds
bullets.body: JPM raises 3Q fiber net adds estimate to 390k from 375k on convergence acceleration; wireless service revenue tracking +4.3% y/y above guidance. FY26 ACS EBITDA seen at +7.0% y/y vs 6%+ guidance. AT&T remains JPM's top pick on analyst focus list with Dec-27 PT of $33 (vs. $25.39 current); 4% EBITDA CAGR and 13% FCF/share CAGR through 2028. Management characterized 2Q as a tipping point.

bullets.title: META: Muse AI hits #1 globally on App Store; agentic TAM and telco disruption risk
bullets.body: META's Muse ranked #1 on iOS App Store globally as of late September 2026, surpassing ChatGPT. Morgan Stanley frames a $30T consumer-spend TAM for agentic AI, with META among the best-positioned. GS TMT notes Muse's automated bill-negotiation capability is pressuring US telcos (AT&T -2%, VZ -3%) on AI agent ARPU spindown risk. MS estimates Meta Muse could add ~1% to 2028 EPS per 100M users.

bullets.title: AVGO/MRVL/ALAB/LITE/CRDO/COHR: Jefferies semis bus tour—demand to far outpace supply
bullets.body: After meeting 13 companies including NVDA CFO, AVGO CEO, MRVL, ALAB, SNDK, LITE, COHR: AI safety monitoring alone adds ~20% incremental compute demand. AVGO: ASIC customers (Anthropic/OpenAI) primary C27/C28 growth drivers, supply constrained across wafers/memory/substrates. MRVL: $1B CXL + $1B custom NIC opportunities in C28. LITE: EPS target raised to $40 by F28, largest OCS supplier to Google next year, margin expansion to 30-35%. ALAB: PCIe scale-up engagements in high teens. CRDO: ZF Optics ~2/3 of $600M+ optics revenue. Optical remains consensus long; semi-cap a tactical funding short given 2028 WFE uncertainty.

bullets.title: TSM: JPM raises CoWoS capacity estimates; demand-supply gap narrows to 10%
bullets.body: JPM raised CoWoS capacity model by 4% in 2027 and 6% in 2028, with TSMC expected to reach 200k/225k wfpm by end 2027/28. The demand-supply gap has narrowed to ~10%; leading-edge wafers and substrates are now the bigger bottlenecks for AI customers, not CoWoS capacity itself. TSMC OW with PT NT$3200. Separately, TSMC reportedly plans three sub-1.4nm fabs in Longtan with >NT$1T investment, first fab targeting mass production by 2030.

bullets.title: MU: Memory shortage worsening; INTC CEO flags 5-7x price increase, shortage deepens in 2027
bullets.body: Intel CEO at AI Infra Summit noted memory prices have risen 5-7x with shortages expected to worsen in 2027—bullish for MU and SNDK. MU's own messaging emphasizes long-term deals and customized designs to address shortages. China's CXMT reportedly building a NAND R&D/pilot line in Beijing, representing a longer-term competitive risk.

bullets.title: AMD: Plans 10% GPU/AI chip price hike in Q4 on rising TSMC costs
bullets.body: Per channel sources cited by UBS and MS, AMD is reportedly planning approximately a 10% price increase for GPUs, AI chips, and chipsets in Q4 2026 to pass through higher TSMC manufacturing costs. Piper Sandler initiates AMD at Overweight. UBS notes hedge funds re-grossed +1.4std into Semis and Memory on Thursday post-FOMC.

bullets.title: MTSI: Upgraded to Outperform at BMO, PT $335; Silicon photonics/CPO testing emerging catalyst
bullets.body: BMO Capital Markets upgraded MTSI to Outperform from Market Perform with a $335 price target; stock up 2.9% pre-market. Separately, NVIDIA's Spectrum-X expansion and the silicon photonics CPO testing bottleneck thesis (moving from roadmap to production) is flagged as a beneficiary dynamic for MTSI and testing vendors including VIAV.

bullets.title: TSEM: Barclays initiates at Overweight, $310 PT; begins high-volume 1.6T optical engine shipments
bullets.body: Barclays initiated Tower Semiconductor at Overweight with a $310 price target; stock up 1.9% pre-market. Separately, Tower and NewPhotonics have begun high-volume shipments of laser-integrated 800G/1.6T optical engines using TSEM's PH18DA SiPho platform—a concrete near-term revenue catalyst.

bullets.title: INTC: +9.8% on reports of SK Hynix US memory chip manufacturing deal
bullets.body: Intel surged 9.8% on reports of a potential US memory chip manufacturing deal with SK Hynix. ARM +8.57% and SMCI +9.50% also led the semis/data center hardware rally. Piper Sandler initiates INTC at Neutral. Semiconductor capital equipment lead times are lengthening—chip equipment waits up to 40 months for critical parts.

bullets.title: MRVL: Expands GlobalFoundries capacity agreement for AI optical connectivity
bullets.body: Marvell and GlobalFoundries signed a multi-year agreement to expand US chip capacity for AI data-center optical connectivity, announced September 17. JPM also highlights $1B CXL and $1B custom NIC attach opportunities in C28 outlook from Jefferies semis tour, with 1.6T optical ramp ongoing.

bullets.title: GNRC: +18% on AMZN $2.4B data-center power supply deal through 2027-28
bullets.body: Generac surged 18% on an Amazon data-center power supply agreement. Citi analysis via Weichai implies ~$441M revenue contribution to Weichai's engine supply business through 2027-28E, with gas engine shipments ramping from 200-300 units in 2026 to ~2,000 in 2027. Citi PT $300 on GNRC, $350 on AMZN.

bullets.title: ACN: Downgraded to Neutral at Guggenheim; IT Services roundtable cautious on FY27 guide
bullets.body: Guggenheim Securities cut Accenture to Neutral from Buy. Citi's IT Services roundtable separately shows investors focused on ACN's August bookings (~$20B+, down 6%+ y/y) and FY27 guide likely 1-5% y/y with 2% inorganic; October 14 Investor Day expectations are low. IBM preferred for year-end positioning.

bullets.title: DKNG: UBS lowers PT to $48, maintains Buy; NY handle +7% YoY but GGR -76% on poor hold rates
bullets.body: DraftKings' NY sportsbook handle growth accelerated to +7% YoY for the week ending Sept 13, but GGR fell 76% YoY as hold rates collapsed 780bps to 2.2%. September MTD handle is -5% YoY. UBS trims FY26 revenue estimate 1% to $6.70B and EBITDA 5% to $789M; FY27/28 estimates similarly lowered. PT cut to $48 from $49 but Buy maintained.

bullets.title: ETSY: Upgraded to Buy at BTIG, $90 PT (+24% upside)
bullets.body: BTIG upgraded Etsy to Buy from Neutral with a $90 price target, implying 24% upside from $72.34. Analyst Marvin Fong cites valuation as a key driver. FactSet consensus target is $89.23. Stock up 1.7% pre-market.

bullets.title: IREN: Initiated Outperform at Northland Capital, $99 PT (128% upside); AI Cloud platform
bullets.body: Northland Capital Markets initiated IREN at Outperform with a $99 price target implying approximately 128% upside. IREN is described as a vertically integrated AI Cloud platform delivering data centers, compute, and software for AI training and inference. Stock up 1.3% pre-market.
